The '''Tieos system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tieos/Legends|Tieos]].
